label: Quest

clips.title: The story
paras: Illiyana searches Ashenvale for her sisters, missing after setting out to recover a stolen relic. She asks travelers to find them in the corrupted ruins of Xavian.

Dryad Illiyana waits in Ashenvale, overwhelmed with worry for her sisters. They left for the corrupted northern reaches of the forest to recover the Branch of Cenarius, a holy relic stolen by satyrs. They promised to return swiftly, but two days have passed without word. Now Illiyana asks passing Alliance travelers to track them down before it is too late.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!
Friend, you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northeast. I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Judging by the gaping wound in her side, Anilia is on the verge of death.
